name: Staff Attendance
desc:
Staff Attendance turns one phone into a time clock for your whole team.
Leave it on the counter. Each person taps their own name to clock in and out — nobody has to install anything, and nobody needs an account. Late arrivals are flagged automatically against the shift you set, overtime is counted past shift end, and short days become half days on their own.
When payday comes, the register is already payroll.
A SHARED DEVICE, NOT AN APP PER PERSON
• Big, tappable name cards — readable across a counter
• Clock in and out with one tap
• Live clock and a running count of who is in, finished, and still to arrive
• Owner side locked behind a 4-digit PIN

name: CPAP Companion
desc:
CPAP Companion is a private, offline log for your PAP therapy. Type in what your
machine shows you each morning, and it keeps the record your sleep clinician
actually asks for.
NIGHTLY LOG
Enter your hours, AHI and leak rate from your machine's own display. Tag any side
effects — dry mouth, swallowed air, congestion, mask soreness, rainout — and add a
note. One entry per morning, so your record stays clean.
ADHERENCE AT A GLANCE
A dashboard gauge shows last night against the 4-hour mark, and a meter tracks the
4-hours-on-70%-of-nights rule that US insurers use. Nights you did not log count

name: CareBinder
desc:
CareBinder is one calm, private place for everything about an aging parent.
If you are the one who keeps track — the appointments, the pill names, the insurance
number the front desk always asks for, where the power of attorney is actually kept —
CareBinder is the binder you would have made by hand.
Everything you enter stays on your iPhone. There is no account, no cloud, no sign-up,
and nothing is ever uploaded.
ONE BINDER PER PARENT
• Their profile: date of birth, blood type, allergies, conditions
• Care contacts: the doctor, the specialist, the pharmacy, the insurance line, the
lawyer, family, aides — tap to call, email or map any of them

name: Reseller Profit Tracker
desc:
Reseller Profit Tracker tells you what a flip ACTUALLY made — after the marketplace
fee, after shipping, after everything.
Log an item the moment you find it. Snap a photo at the counter, enter what you paid,
and follow it through Sourced → Listed → Sold. When it sells, pick the marketplace and
the app applies that platform's fee, subtracts your shipping, adds what the buyer paid,
and shows you the net and the ROI. No mental arithmetic at the end of the month.
FREE MARKETPLACE FEE CALCULATOR
Standing in a shop wondering whether it's worth it? Open the calculator, enter the

name: Kidney eGFR Tracker
desc:
Kidney eGFR Tracker is a personal log for people living with chronic kidney disease
and for the family members who help them keep track.
Enter your lab results and the app estimates your GFR using the race-free CKD-EPI 2021
equation, charts how it has moved over time, and shows where the value sits against the
published KDIGO reference bands — so you can walk into your next appointment with the
whole picture in one place.
WHAT YOU CAN LOG
• Lab results — creatinine, BUN, eGFR, ACR, potassium, phosphorus, sodium, calcium,
haemoglobin and albumin
• Dialysis sessions — type, centre, access, duration, pre/post weight, fluid removed

name: Homeschool Record Keeper
desc:
Homeschool Record Keeper is a private, offline record book for homeschooling families.
Log what you taught, track the days and hours you are required to show, keep grades and
work samples, and turn all of it into a document whenever someone asks for one.
WHAT YOU CAN KEEP
• Lessons — subject, date, minutes, title and notes, in a date-grouped timeline
• Attendance — tap a calendar to mark school days; add a manual hours override for a
day that does not fit the lesson log
• Subjects — colour-coded, with optional credit hours for the transcript
• Grades — letter, percentage or Pass/Fail, per subject, with a running GPA

name: Seizure Log
desc:
Seizure Log is a private diary for people living with epilepsy, and for the families and carers who help them.
ONE TAP TO RECORD
The moment a seizure begins, one tap starts a live duration timer. Stop it when the seizure ends and the entry is saved. Every other field is optional — you can fill in the details later, when things are calm.
WHAT YOU CAN RECORD
• Duration, date and time
• Seven seizure types following ILAE-style classification
• Severity, aura and warning signs, recovery time
• Whether a carer logged it, and whether it was recorded on video
• Possible triggers — sleep, stress, missed doses, illness, light, alcohol

name: DeliveryLog
desc:
DeliveryLog tells you what a shift actually paid — after fuel, after mileage, after everything.
LOG A DELIVERY IN SECONDS
Record the platform, the pay, the tip and the distance. Tips can be added later when they land, so a cash tip at the door does not get lost.
SEE REAL PROFIT, NOT JUST EARNINGS
Deliveries, earnings, tips, expenses and profit for today, this week, this month or any range you pick. Expenses come off the top, so the number you see is the number you kept.
MILEAGE AND TAX
Track distance per delivery and per shift, and get an IRS standard-mileage estimate for the year. Bring a real figure to tax time instead of a guess.

name: CustodyLog Court Diary
desc:
CustodyLog is a private, one-sided custody documentation diary for separated parents. Log exchanges, incidents, expenses, and communications with dual timestamps, then export a court-ready PDF when you need it.
WHAT YOU CAN LOG:
• Exchanges — on-time, late, or no-show with notes and photos
• Incidents, missed visits, medical visits, school events, milestones
• Shared expenses with reimbursement status
• Parenting-time schedules and overnight counts
• Amendment trail — entries lock after 24 hours; corrections become dated amendments
COURT-READY OUTPUT:
• Formatted PDF report with entries, photos, expenses, and amendments

name: DishSync
desc:
Cooking a full dinner means juggling four timers in your head. DishSync runs them all for you — and makes every dish land on the table at the same time.
MULTIPLE NAMED TIMERS
Run as many timers as your dinner needs, each with its own name, color and alarm. The dashboard shows every countdown at a glance.
SYNC TO FINISH TOGETHER
Tell DishSync when you want to serve, and it tells you when to start each dish. No more cold sides next to a hot roast.
PRESET LIBRARY
Common timings built in — pasta, rice, eggs, roast chicken and more. Save your own presets for the dishes you cook every week.

name: SipSense
desc:
That 4 PM espresso is why you're staring at the ceiling at midnight. SipSense shows you exactly how much caffeine is in your system — and when to stop.
ONE-TAP LOGGING
A built-in beverage library covers coffee, espresso drinks, tea, energy drinks and sodas. Log your usual in one tap, or add custom drinks.
DAILY LIMIT RING
Watch your intake fill a progress ring toward the commonly referenced 400 mg daily guideline.
CAFFEINE DECAY
See a live estimate of caffeine leaving your system through the day, based on its typical half-life.
SMART CUTOFF TIME
Tell SipSense your bedtime and it calculates when your last caffeinated sip should be.

name: StoryNight
desc:
StoryNight turns bedtime into a cozy ritual. Choose a story, add your child's name and their favourite things, and it becomes their story — read on screen or read aloud to them. Everything stays on your device, and no account is needed.
21 ORIGINAL BEDTIME STORIES
Every story is written for this app and runs a full 12 pages, across seven shelves: Adventure, Fairy Tale, Space, Ocean, Sleepy Time, Animals and Magic. Each one is written to wind down — the last pages are quiet, and every story ends on a goodnight.

name: UsageLog
desc:
UsageLog is a simple way for parents to keep track of how much screen time each child actually gets — a journal, not a blocker. Log a session in seconds, set a daily goal per child, and see where the week really went.
WHAT YOU CAN DO:
• Add a profile for each child, with their own avatar and daily goal
• Log a session in seconds — tap a duration, a device and what it was for
• Set your usual session length and device once, and the Log tab opens ready
• Watch today's progress against each child's goal on a balance meter that turns amber near the limit and coral past it
• See a weekly report with a clear breakdown by day and category

name: FamilyDinner
desc:
Dinner is the one time the whole family is in the same place. FamilyDinner helps you make it count — decide what's on the table, see who's home, and always have something better to talk about than "how was school?"
No account. No sign-up. Everything stays on your iPhone.
WHAT'S ON THE TABLE
Pick tonight's meal from your own saved list. FamilyDinner remembers when you last served each one, so you can stop making the same three dinners on repeat.
WHO'S AT THE TABLE
Add everyone in the family and mark who's home tonight. A quick tap tells you how many places to set.

name: BedtimeBox
desc:
BedtimeBox turns the nightly routine into something your child can follow on their own. Build a wind-down — bath, pyjamas, teeth, story, lights out — and let them tap through it step by step, with a timer for each one.
WHAT YOU CAN DO:
• Build a bedtime routine from simple, picture-led steps
• Let your child tap through it themselves, one step at a time
• Finish on a "Great Job!" celebration screen
• Watch the streak grow as good nights add up
• Keep a profile per child, with their own avatar and colour
• No account, no sign-up — your children's details stay on your device
BEDTIMEBOX PREMIUM
• Unlimited children — the free plan covers one

name: TeachKit
desc:
TeachKit is the all-in-one toolkit that helps teachers run their classroom from a single, beautifully simple app. Take attendance in seconds, keep a clean gradebook, track homework, plan your timetable, log behavior, and turn it all into clear reports and charts — no spreadsheets, no clutter.
Built for real classrooms and designed to work fully offline, TeachKit keeps your students' data private and right at your fingertips.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
Attendance
- Mark present, absent, late, or excused with a single tap
- Mark the whole class present or absent at once
- See attendance rates per student and per class at a glance

name: DeepBlock
desc:
DeepBlock helps you carve out protected deep work time by scheduling focus blocks throughout your day. Plan tomorrow the night before, commit to your blocks, and finally get the most important work done.
WHAT YOU CAN DO:
• Session Planning — Create work sessions with task name, duration (15-120 min), and priority
• Focus Timer — Countdown timer with progress ring
• Ambient Sounds — Rain, white noise, cafe, forest, ocean, silence
• Daily Session Log — Track completed/skipped/interrupted sessions
• Session Streaks — Consecutive day tracking
• Daily Focus Goals — Set and track daily deep work hour targets

name: QuizBuilder
desc:
QuizBuilder turns anything you need to memorise into a quiz you can actually practise. Write your own questions, run timed practice, and watch your scores climb — no account, no cloud, no sign-up.
Built for students, language learners, and anyone studying for an exam or a certification.
WHAT YOU CAN DO:
• Daily Drill — a short set every day, drawn from across your quizzes and weighted toward previously incorrect answers. Build a streak. Free, no subscription.
• Build your own quizzes — multiple choice, true/false, or written answer
• Add an explanation to any question, so a wrong answer teaches you something

name: TypeMaster
desc:
TypeMaster is a fast, focused typing-speed trainer for iPhone. Hit Drill, type the text on screen, and watch your live WPM and per-key accuracy tick in real time. No sign-up, no clutter — just a clean way to get faster and more accurate every day.
Unlike most typing apps, TypeMaster's drill field disables iOS auto-correct, auto-capitalization, and smart quotes while you type, so the keyboard never fights your test. Your speed score is your speed score.
FREE, EVERY DAY:
• Live WPM and accuracy on every drill
• 5 typing drills per day (resets at midnight)
• A 60-second Daily Challenge, once per day
• 7-day rolling history of your drills

name: ConceptMap
desc:
ConceptMap turns a blank canvas into a mind map in seconds — brainstorm a project, outline an essay, or break a big decision into branches, all with a drag-and-connect canvas that stays on your device. No account, no sign-up, no cloud sync required.
START FAST WITH TEMPLATES:
• Brainstorm Starter template gets you a root node with four branches instantly
• Full canvas editor — drag nodes, draw connections, recolor branches, two zoom levels
• Snap-to-grid alignment keeps every map tidy
• Export any map to PNG, watermark-free
• Apple Shortcuts: "Open Last Map" and "New ConceptMap" from Siri or the Shortcuts app

name: PainMap Body Pain Tracker
desc:
PainMap is a private, on-device pain diary for people living with chronic pain, fibromyalgia, arthritis, migraines, or back pain. Tap a body diagram to mark exactly where it hurts, rate the intensity, track your triggers, and share a clear report with your doctor. No account, no cloud - your health data stays on your iPhone.
INTERACTIVE BODY DIAGRAM
- Tap the front or back body view to mark pain locations
- Color-coded by intensity (mild to severe)
- Multiple locations per entry
LOG EVERY DETAIL
- Intensity 1-10, pain type, time of day, duration
- Triggers: activity, stress, weather, food, sleep, exercise
- Notes per entry

name: FactStack
desc:
FactStack delivers one genuinely interesting, source-attributable fact every day — no clickbait myths, no login, no cluttered feed. Open the app, read today's curated fact, save the ones you love, and build a private library of knowledge over time.
FREE, EVERY DAY:
• One new curated fact per day, every day
• 3 always-free themed packs: Science, History, Space
• 30-day fact history
• Unlimited favorites, saved on your device
• Your learning stats — facts viewed, favorites, streak and 7-day total
• Search inside today's facts and your history
• Native iOS share sheet
• No account, no login — everything lives on your device

name: MapQuiz
desc:
MapQuiz turns the world map into a daily habit. Test yourself on countries, capitals, flags, continents, and population across 108 countries spanning every region on Earth — no account, no sign-up, just open the app and play.
FREE, RIGHT NOW:
• Country Quiz — name the country a capital city belongs to
• Capital Quiz — name the capital city of a country
• Flag Quiz — identify the country from its flag
• Continent Quiz — place a country on the correct continent
• Region Focus packs for World, Africa, and Europe — drill one part of the map at a time

name: CodeSnippets
desc:
Tired of digging through old projects for that one useful piece of code? CodeSnippets is your personal code library — always organized, always ready, and completely private.
SAVE ANY CODE
Paste or type snippets in 20+ programming languages — Swift, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java, Kotlin, HTML, CSS, SQL, Bash, Ruby, PHP, C#, C++, Dart, YAML, JSON, Markdown, R, and Lua. Every snippet gets automatic syntax highlighting for keywords, strings, comments, and numbers.

name: SkillPath
desc:
SkillPath turns "I want to learn X" into a real roadmap. Set a skill, give it a target in hours, break it into milestones, and log every practice session — the home screen tracks your progress as a chartreuse ring so you always know how close you are to mastery. Everything lives on your device: no account, no cloud, no login wall.
HOW IT WORKS:
• Add a skill (a language, an instrument, a craft — anything) and set a target in hours
• Break it into milestones you write yourself, like a curriculum
• Log each practice session with minutes, notes, and a 1–5 rating
• Watch the progress ring fill as your practice hours add up

name: SymptomSnap
desc:
Living with symptoms you can't quite explain? SymptomSnap turns scattered "I think it was worse last Tuesday" into a clear record you can actually show a doctor.
ONE-TAP LOGGING
Five fixed tiles on the home screen — Fever, Cough, Headache, Fatigue, Nausea — log the common ones in a single tap. For everything else, rate severity on a 1-10 slider, tag what may have triggered it (food, stress, weather, poor sleep, medication, exercise, alcohol, caffeine), pin the body location, note any medication and dose, and add a free-text note.

name: PhrasePocket
desc:
PhrasePocket is a privacy-first, offline travel phrasebook. Pick your destination's language, tap a category, tap a phrase — and hear it spoken aloud in Apple's native locale voice. The entire phrase corpus ships inside the app, so it works in airplane mode, on a train with no signal, or roaming abroad without a data plan. No account, no cloud sync, no analytics — the only thing PhrasePocket remembers is the phrases you star.
HOW IT WORKS:
• Choose your travel language
• Tap a category — Greetings, Food, Directions, Emergency, Transport, Accommodation, and more
• Tap a phrase to hear it spoken in a real native-locale voice

name: LexiMind
desc:
LexiMind is a vocabulary builder for people who take words seriously — a real SM-2 spaced-repetition engine, dictionary-quality definitions, and a daily word delivered with proper context, wrapped in a clean iPhone-native shell. No account, no cloud — your word library lives on your device.
HOW IT WORKS:
• Add words from anything you're reading — books, articles, classes — no deck limits
• Review with a true SM-2 algorithm, the same spacing method behind Anki
• Every word ships with a definition, part-of-speech, and an example sentence
• A new Daily Word arrives at the hour you choose
• Track your streak and see how many reviews are due today

name: ParchmentBox
desc:
ParchmentBox is a quiet home for the passages that move you. Paste a quote from a book, article, podcast, tweet, or conversation, tag it, and it becomes part of a private library that resurfaces itself — one highlight a day, right when you want to see it again.
No account. No sync servers. No feed. Everything lives on your device.
WHAT YOU CAN DO:
• Paste any passage and save it in seconds — pick a source template (Book, Article, Podcast, Tweet, Conversation) so every highlight is properly attributed
• Tag highlights and browse your whole library by tag
• Search across every saved highlight and book

name: MedCabinet
desc:
MedCabinet is a private, on-device medication tracker that keeps your pill schedule, dose reminders, and refill predictions in one place - with no account, no email, and no cloud. Your health data never leaves your iPhone.
FREE
- Track medications with custom dose schedules
- Dose reminders (local notifications)
- Adherence streak + 30-day history
- On-screen "running low" refill prediction
MEDCABINET PREMIUM - $2.99/month
- Refill alert notifications (lead-time you choose)
- Caregiver / family member sharing
- Unlimited medications
- Advanced dose schedules
- Ad-Free

name: HydraDrop
desc:
HydraDrop is a private, on-device water-intake tracker that makes hitting your daily hydration goal effortless. Log every glass with one tap, watch your progress ring fill, and build a streak. No account, no cloud sync - your data stays on your iPhone.
FREE
- Unlimited water entries
- Two cup presets (Small / Large Glass)
- Daily progress ring + 7-day history
- An adaptive in-app reminder
- Daily reminder notification
HYDRADROP PREMIUM - $2.99/month
- Smart Goal Calibration - a recommended daily target from your weight, activity, and climate
- Adaptive Reminder Cadence - interval reminders inside a work-hours window, quiet outside it

name: SunTracker UV Vitamin D
desc:
SunTracker helps you enjoy the sun safely. Track your sun exposure, see the current UV index, and get a personalized vitamin D estimate - all calibrated to your skin type and SPF.
FREE
- Current UV index for your location
- Session timer that survives backgrounding
- Today's session history
- Skin-type (Fitzpatrick) + SPF calibration
- Vitamin D estimate per session, with the formula shown
- Burn-risk notification at the end of a session
SUNTRACKER PREMIUM - $2.99/month
- 7-day UV forecast personalized to your skin type
- Multi-session chaining (cumulative vitamin D + burn risk)
- Weekly & monthly statistics
- Apple Health vitamin D logging
- CSV export

name: KickOff26
desc: KickOff26 is your offline digital wall chart for the summer 2026 soccer tournament — all 12 groups, every fixture, and the full knockout tree, in your pocket. No account. No sign-up. No live-score server to break on the biggest match days.

name: CashEnvelope
desc:
Digital envelopes, kitchen-table simple. CashEnvelope brings the classic cash-stuffing method to your iPhone — no bank link, no account, no analytics. Stuff your paycheck into envelopes for Rent, Groceries, Fun, and Savings, watch the liquid fill bars tick down as you spend, and stay in control of every dollar.
WHAT YOU CAN DO:
• Envelope Wall — every envelope on one screen with live liquid-fill cards (green on track, amber near limit, red over budget)
• Add Transactions — log spending in two taps, see the wall update instantly
• Pace Forecast — projects each envelope's end-of-month landing before you actually overspend

name: MatchPool
desc:
MatchPool turns the summer 2026 soccer tournament into a friendly prediction league. Create
a pool, share a 6-character join code, and everyone predicts the scoreline for every match.
The app does the maths and ranks your group on a live leaderboard — all you have to do is
call it right.
This is a game for fun and bragging rights. There is no real-money wagering, no betting, no
odds and no prizes of any kind.
WHY MATCHPOOL
• See exactly how you score — tap any match for a full points breakdown (exact score, correct
margin, correct result). No mystery points.
• Works offline — all 104 fixtures are bundled, with kickoff times and venues.

name: BreathSpace
desc:
BreathSpace is a guided breathing app that helps you calm your mind, reduce stress, and build a daily practice. Choose a pattern, follow the animated breathing ring, and let ambient sounds guide each inhale and exhale.
FREE
- Guided breathing patterns (Box, 4-7-8, Calm, and more)
- Animated breath ring with phase cues
- Ambient sounds
- Daily practice tracking + streak
BREATHSPACE PREMIUM - $2.99/month
- Custom Breathing Patterns - design and save your own inhale / hold / exhale rhythm
- Full pattern library
- Full ambient sound library
- Ad-Free
Auto-renews monthly. Cancel anytime in your Apple ID settings.

name: FootyQuiz
desc:
Football isn't a list of questions — it's a match. So FootyQuiz turns every round into one.
The clock runs from the 5th minute to full time. Each question is a phase of play, and every correct answer puts a GOAL on the scoreboard. Pick your answer from four kit-coloured jersey panels, watch the minute tick, and chase a clean full-time result.
WHY FOOTYQUIZ IS DIFFERENT
- A real match feel — running match clock, live scoreboard, goals instead of points.
- 600 hand-authored, fact-checked questions across six packs. Settled history only — no questions that go stale next season.

name: LoanLens
desc:
See what your loans really cost — and how to crush them faster. LoanLens is a private, on-device loan tracker that turns every mortgage, auto loan, student debt, personal line, or credit card balance into a clear picture of interest paid, projected payoff date, and the months you could save with a few extra payments. No bank linkage, no account, no analytics.
WHAT YOU CAN DO:
• Loan Lens Hero — one signature widget on the home screen showing your focus loan's principal-vs-interest stacked bar, projected payoff date, lifetime interest dollars, and total loan count at a glance

name: Penalty Hero
desc:
Step up to the spot. Penalty Hero is the penalty-shootout game where you play BOTH ends of every duel — first you swipe to shoot, then you switch ends and dive to save. No rigged luck: the physics are fair and learnable, so the better you read the angle, power and curve, the more you score.
SWIPE TO SHOOT
Flick the ball with a swipe. The angle aims it, the length powers it, and a curved swipe bends it around the keeper. The same swipe always produces the same shot — master the curl into the top corner.

name: CycleNote
desc:
CycleNote is a private, on-device menstrual cycle journal. Log your period, flow, mood, energy, temperature, and symptoms, and CycleNote estimates your next period and fertile window from your own past cycles. No account, no cloud sync - your cycle log stays in the app on your iPhone.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your cycle entries stay in the app on your iPhone - no sign-in, no account servers, and your health data is never shared with us or anyone else. The free tier shows ads: if you allow tracking when iOS asks, an advertising identifier is used to measure them, and you can change that at any time in iOS Settings. Premium removes ads.

name: NapCraft
desc:
NapCraft is a science-based power-nap timer with gentle wake alarms that help you recharge without the grogginess. Pick a nap length, drift off, and wake up before you slip into deep sleep.
FREE
- 10 and 20 minute nap presets
- 3 gentle alarm sounds
- 7-day nap history
NAPCRAFT PREMIUM - $2.99/month
- All presets (10 / 20 / 26 / 90 min) plus custom durations
- Full gentle-sound library
- Unlimited nap history
- Apple Health sync
- Energy tracking - rate your energy before and after each nap
- Nap IQ - a personal nap coach that learns your best nap length and time of day from your own history
Auto-renews monthly. Cancel anytime in your Apple ID settings.

name: TaxPot
desc:
Freelance income shouldn't mean tax-season panic. TaxPot gives you a running, on-device estimate of what you owe — every time you add a payment or a deductible — so you walk into April 15 already knowing the number.
No account required. No bank linking. Your income and deduction records stay on your phone.
WHY TAXPOT
Most tax apps are seasonal, intimidating, and demand you connect your bank and create yet another login. TaxPot flips that. Open the app, tap a button, and your year-to-date tax estimate updates in real time. It's the ledger a freelancer actually wants: fast to log, honest about what you owe, and quiet about your data.

name: TipPilot
desc:
Tip smarter. Split cleaner. Track every gratuity.
TipPilot is the tip calculator with a memory. Pick the context — dine-in, delivery, bar, takeout, ride, or service — drop in the bill, and we apply the right tip percentage for that situation. Split it across the table, round the total to a clean number, and save the entry to a private on-device history. Over time, TipPilot learns how generous you are at brunch versus at the bar, and surfaces your average tip percent, monthly total, and tipper-personality badge right on the Home screen.
Built for diners, regulars, and service-industry workers who want to know exactly what they tipped — and why.

name: Project Hub
desc:
Project Hub is the simplest way to talk to a developer about your idea — directly, in real time.
Whether you need a website, a mobile or desktop app, a SaaS product, an AI solution, an automation tool, a dashboard, an online store, or help with a university project, assignment, or research — open Project Hub and start a conversation. No forms, no waiting on email. Just chat.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Pick what you want to build.
2. Message the developer directly.
3. Describe your idea and get it built.
WHAT YOU CAN DISCUSS
• Websites & landing pages
• iOS & cross-platform apps
• Desktop applications
• SaaS products & dashboards
• AI solutions & chatbots

name: PostureTimer
desc:
PostureTimer is a private, time-based posture coach for desk workers. Set a reminder cadence and PostureTimer nudges you to stand, stretch, and reset on every interval inside your work-hours window. No camera, no motion sensors, no HealthKit - your session log lives entirely on your device.
HONEST BY DESIGN
PostureTimer is TIME-BASED. It does not use the camera or sensors to detect your actual posture. Reminders fire on a schedule; staying upright is up to you.
FREE
- One reminder interval (30 min, 9am-5pm)
- 5 starter desk stretches with step-by-step timers
- Today's compliance ring + last-7-days mini chart
- Manual timer start/stop

name: CurrencyDiary
desc: See what every trip really costs — in your home currency. CurrencyDiary is a private, on-device travel-spend tracker. Open a trip, log every expense in the local currency, and CurrencyDiary instantly converts it to your home currency, surfaces live FX deltas with up/down arrows, and (Premium) auto-tags every entry with the city you logged it in. No account, no bank linkage, no analytics.

name: VisionBreak
desc:
VisionBreak protects your eyes from digital screen strain using the proven 20-20-20 rule: every 20 minutes, look 20 feet away for 20 seconds. Unlike reminders you swipe away and ignore, VisionBreak can lock the screen for the full break so you actually rest your eyes.
FREE
- 20-20-20 timer plus 30 / 45 / 60-minute presets
- 3 break types (Quick Look-Away, Walk, Stretch)
- Today's compliance ring + 7-day history
- 5 starter eye-care tips
- Theme switching
VISIONBREAK PREMIUM - $2.99/month
- Custom 5-120 minute intervals
- Full sound library (8+ chimes)
- Full statistics - weekly/monthly compliance, streaks, work-hours heatmap
- 50+ eye-care tip library

name: CartPulse
desc:
Track every grocery dollar before you get to the register.
CartPulse is the budget-first grocery companion that watches your cart total in real time, remembers what each item used to cost, and tells you whether the price on the shelf is a deal, normal, or a spike. Set a budget for the trip, scan the Cart Pulse bar slide from green to amber to red, and walk out without that "wait, how did I spend that much?" feeling.
No accounts. No cloud. No ads tracking what's in your basket. Everything stays on your iPhone.

name: MatchNight
desc:
MatchNight turns any game day into an easy, organized watch party — and it works entirely offline with no account to create.
Whether you're hosting a match, an NFL Sunday, a season finale, or a birthday gathering, MatchNight gives you one clean kit to run the whole evening.
PLAN ANY EVENT, ANY TIME
• Build a party around a bundled Summer 2026 fixture OR a fully custom event of your own.
• Every kickoff and start time shows in YOUR local timezone — no more confused guests doing time-zone math.
• Set how early guests should arrive and get a reminder before the party starts.

name: SettleTab
desc:
Who paid for the rideshare? Whose turn was it to grab the groceries? How much does Sam still owe from the cabin trip?
SettleTab is the calmest way to split a bill with the people in your life. Open a tab for the trip, the dinner, or the shared apartment, drop expenses in as they happen, and let SettleTab work out the minimum settlements automatically — who pays who, exactly how much, and when.
No bank login. No email signup. No cloud account quietly syncing your dinner receipts to a server you have never heard of. Just a beautiful, private, on-device tracker that lives on your iPhone and asks nothing of you.

name: Bill Pulse
desc:
Never miss a bill or pay for a forgotten subscription again.
Bill Pulse is a calm, private bill and subscription tracker for people juggling rent, utilities, streaming services, gym memberships, software trials, and every other recurring charge. Add a bill in ten seconds and see exactly what is due, when, and how much you are spending each month.
No bank login. No account. No ads slowing you down. Just a clean, modern timeline of every recurring payment in your life.
WHY PEOPLE LOVE BILL PULSE
- See your next seven days at a glance with the Pulse Bar timeline on the home screen

name: NetWorthNow
desc:
NetWorthNow is a private wealth tracker that turns what you own and what you owe into a single trend line you can watch climb. No bank logins. No email signup. Your assets, debts and net-worth history live on your device.
Add your assets — cash, investments, property, vehicles, retirement, crypto, the random things only you remember — and the debts that sit against them. Tap one button to snapshot your net worth today, and NetWorthNow does the rest: a 30-day sparkline, a delta arrow, and a live breakdown of where your money actually lives.

name: Inbox Zero
desc:
Inbox Zero — Email Sorter is a reply-time tracker for busy professionals. Log incoming emails, set response targets per priority, snooze for follow-up, and watch your Inbox Score climb as you reply on time.
WHAT YOU CAN DO:
• Track every pending email with priority, age, and missed-target badges
• Set per-priority response windows (Urgent / High / Medium / Low) with on-time reminders
• Snooze emails into a Follow-Up list grouped Overdue / Today / Later
• Build auto-sorting rules that classify new emails by keyword
• Watch your weekly Inbox Score with a four-quadrant breakdown
• Smart tips appear when your backlog grows or targets are missed

name: RetainerLedger
desc:
RetainerLedger is the privacy-first invoicing app built for freelancers, consultants, and small service businesses who get paid for their time. No account, no cloud sync, no analytics — your clients, invoices, and receivables live on your device, period.
Most invoicing apps want a credit card, an email, and a tour through a full accounting suite before you can send a single PDF. RetainerLedger takes the opposite approach: open the app, add a client, send a polished invoice in under a minute. Track who paid, who's late, and what's due next — all from one calm, focused screen.

name: TimeAudit Hour Ledger
desc:
TimeAudit helps you see exactly where your time goes. Tag every block of your day, review weekly breakdowns, and discover time sinks you didn't even realize existed.
WHAT YOU CAN DO:
• Log every hour of your day on a 24-cell timeline
• One-tap Quick Log Presets for the things you track most
• A planned-vs-actual Variance Ring shows where today went off track
• Anomaly Inbox flags long unbroken sessions, spending spikes and blank days
• Weekly Story cards narrate what changed since last week
• No sign-up and no account — every entry stays on your device
TIMEAUDIT PREMIUM — $2.99/month:
• Unlimited time entries
• Custom categories

name: PriorityStack
desc:
PriorityStack uses the Ivy Lee method: each night, write down tomorrow's 6 most important tasks in priority order. Tackle them one at a time. Simple, proven, and life-changing.
WHAT YOU CAN DO:
• The Ivy Lee Method — rank tomorrow's 6 most important tasks tonight, tackle them one at a time
• Daily reflection log with mood and notes
• Recurring tasks that auto-populate on the right weekday
• Quick-capture inbox for stray ideas before they're lost
• Focus sessions with interruption tracking
• No sign-up and no account — your stacks stay on your device
PRIORITYSTACK PREMIUM — $2.99/month:
• Unlimited daily stacks
• Full history and analytics

name: MeetingNotes
desc:
MeetingNotes is a focused, templated note app for meetings. Use action-item, decision, and Q&A templates, assign follow-ups, and never lose a commitment again.
WHAT YOU CAN DO:
• Templated notes for action items, decisions and Q&A
• Assign follow-ups and track them through to done
• Attendee management per meeting
• Search across every meeting and every note
• Export any meeting to Markdown to share or archive
• No sign-up and no account — every note stays on your device
MEETINGNOTES PREMIUM — $2.99/month:
• Unlimited notes and templates
• Action item tracking
• Attendee management
• Export to Markdown
• Search and tags
• Every future update included

name: MeetingCost
desc:
MeetingCost instantly calculates the real cost of any meeting based on attendees' salaries. See the dollar meter tick up live during meetings and rethink every unnecessary invite.
WHAT YOU CAN DO:
• Live Cost Ticker — Real-time cost calculation with per-second updates
• Meeting Setup — Configure attendees, rates, meeting name
• Meeting History — Past meetings with cost, duration, filterable
• Meeting Templates — Save recurring meeting configurations
• Rate Profiles — Different hourly rates for teams/departments
• Cost Budget — Weekly/monthly meeting cost budgets
• Statistics — Weekly/monthly cost charts, averages
• CSV Export — Export meeting reports

name: ClipVault Snippet Box
desc:
ClipVault is a private, on-device clipboard manager and snippet library. Save URLs, notes, text, and code snippets, organize them into folders, and paste them back with one tap.
WHAT YOU CAN DO:
• Universal vault search with kind filters (URL, email, phone, code, number, text)
• Pin your most-used clips to the top, star favourites into their own tab
• Auto-detects what you copied and offers one-tap quick actions — open, call, email, share, QR
• Duplicate cleanup finds identical clips and merges them in one tap
• Organize into folders ("drawers") and bulk-select to pin, star or delete
• No sign-up and no account — every clip stays on your device

name: ChunkIt
desc:
ChunkIt is a task-chunking app that breaks big, overwhelming goals into small, doable steps. Drag tasks into chunks, check them off, and watch your impossible project become manageable.
WHAT YOU CAN DO:
• Task Chunking — Create a big task (e.g., "Clean House") and split into N timed chunks (e.g., 5 × 10 min)
• Auto-Suggest Chunk Sizes — Based on task complexity: Simple → 5 min, Medium → 15 min, Complex → 25 min
• Built-in Focus Timer per Chunk — Countdown timer for the active chunk with pause/resume/skip controls
• Pomodoro-Style Work/Break Flow — Automatic short break (5 min) between chunks, long break (15 min) after every 4 chunks

name: SpellBee
desc:
SpellBee is a fun, friendly spelling practice app designed to build strong spelling skills. Hear a word, type it, and get instant feedback with cheerful animations. Grade-leveled word banks, daily challenges, and streak tracking help keep learning engaging and consistent.
WHAT YOU CAN DO:
• Spelling Practice — Hear a word, type it, and get instant feedback with letter tile animations
• Grade-Level Words — K–6 word banks with 50+ carefully selected words per grade
• Daily Challenge — 10-word daily challenge to build streaks
• Text-to-Speech — AVSpeechSynthesizer with adjustable speed (slow/normal/fast)

name: QuoteVault
desc:
QuoteVault is a daily inspirational quotes app with 500+ curated quotes across ten categories. Save your favourites, turn any quote into a designed share card, keep a private Reflection Journal, and build a personal collection of the lines that stay with you.
WHAT YOU CAN DO:
• Open a new hand-picked quote every day
• Browse 500+ quotes across ten categories, all free
• Search by word or author, or browse by category
• Favourite anything and add your own quotes
• Group what matters into collections
• Turn a quote into a designed card and share it
• Write a few lines about today's quote in your Reflection Journal and keep a reflection streak

name: FlashGenius
desc:
FlashGenius is a smart flashcard study app powered by the SM-2 spaced repetition algorithm. Create decks, flip through beautiful 3D cards, and let the app schedule reviews for peak retention. Perfect for exam prep, language learning, and lifelong learners.
WHAT YOU CAN DO:
• Create unlimited decks organized by subject, color, and icon
• Study with beautiful 3D flip-card animations
• SM-2 spaced repetition algorithm for peak retention
• Four-button difficulty rating (Again / Hard / Good / Easy)
• Daily review queue — the app tells you what to study
• AI-powered card generation from any topic (premium)
• Retention analytics and progress charts

name: BabyLog
desc:
BabyLog is a gentle, one-tap tracker for new parents. Log feeds, diapers, and sleep in seconds, watch growth over time, and celebrate milestones — all without creating an account.
WHAT YOU CAN DO:
• Quick-tap diaper logging — one tap saves immediately
• Feeding timer for breast + quick-amount logging for bottle
• Sleep timer that keeps running while you move around the app
• Growth charts for weight and length
• Milestone tracking organized by developmental category
• Medicine, temperature and pumping logs, with the last dose, reading or session shown at a glance
• 7-day statistics for feeds, sleep, and diapers

name: FocusForge
desc:
FocusForge is a Pomodoro timer built for deep work. Start a session, tag it, and let the timer carry you through focus and breaks without you having to think about it. Come back later to see exactly where your focused hours actually went.
No account and no cloud sync: your sessions, streaks and stats stay on your device.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Run a focus session — a calm circular timer that moves between work and break on its own
• Tag what you worked on — Study, Work, Creative, Exercise, Reading or Other, each with its own colour
• Pick your rhythm — classic Pomodoro (25/5), Long Focus (50/10), Quick Burst (15/3), or build your own

name: MoodTrack
desc:
MoodTrack is a calm, private daily mood journal with HealthKit integration. Log how you feel in seconds, write optional journal entries, and discover what lifts your mood through beautiful charts and correlations with your sleep, steps, and exercise.
WHAT YOU CAN DO:
• Log your mood in 5 taps with a beautiful, calming interface
• Write optional daily journal entries with rich formatting
• See mood trends on weekly, monthly, and yearly charts
• HealthKit correlations — see how sleep, steps, and exercise affect your mood
• Calendar view with color-coded mood days
• Insight cards reveal patterns you didn't notice

name: ReadingLog
desc:
ReadingLog is a beautiful personal book tracker for avid readers. Search Open Library to add any book instantly, time your reading sessions, save notes and favorite quotes, and visualize your yearly reading journey through elegant charts.
WHAT YOU CAN DO:
• Library Management — Add books manually or search Open Library API
• Reading Sessions — Timer-based tracking with page progress
• Notes & Quotes — Save notes and favorite quotes per book
• Reading Statistics — Swift Charts: books/month, pages/month, time trends
• Reading Goals — Annual book target with progress tracking
• Premium IAP — Monthly subscription (free=10 books limit, premium=unlimited)

name: BudgetBee
desc:
BudgetBee is a simple, beautiful personal budget and expense tracker with a honey-gold design. Log expenses in seconds, set category budgets, and see exactly where your money goes through clean charts — all stored locally on your device.
WHAT YOU CAN DO:
• Log expenses and income in seconds with a honey-gold interface
• Dashboard with live budget progress ring
• Category management — food, transport, bills, and more
• Set monthly budgets per category with smart alerts
• Spending pie chart and trend line analytics
• Recurring transaction automation
• CSV data export for taxes and records
• Multi-currency support
• Daily log reminder notifications

name: StoryBoard
desc:
StoryBoard is the fastest way to plan films, ads, comics, and social videos on iPhone and iPad. Sketch panels with Apple Pencil, drop in reference photos, pick professional camera angles, and export a polished PDF.
WHAT YOU CAN DO:
• Project Management — Create, edit, delete, and duplicate storyboard projects
• PencilKit Drawing — Full drawing canvas with pen/pencil/marker/eraser (finger + Apple Pencil)
• Photo Import — Import photos from library via PhotosUI PhotosPicker
• Camera Angles — 10 professional camera angle presets per panel
• Templates — 11 predefined templates (film, ad, social media, comic)

name: HabitGrid
desc:
Habit Grid helps you build and maintain daily habits with a beautiful GitHub-style contribution grid.
• Habit Tracking — Create habits and tap to complete them each day.
• Contribution Grid — See your consistency as a color-intensity grid over time.
• Streak Tracking — Track current streak, best streak, and total completions.
• Flexible Scheduling — Set habits for daily, specific days, or X times per week.
• Streak Celebrations — Confetti and milestones at 7, 14, 30, 100, and 365 days.
• Daily Reminders — Get notified so you never miss a habit.
Features:
• No account required. Works offline.
HabitGrid Premium ($2.99/month):
• Unlimited habits

name: Math Tables
desc:
MathTables is a beautiful, private, iPhone-native tool that helps you stay on top of what matters. Clean design, no accounts, no tracking, works offline.
WHAT YOU CAN DO:
• Table Viewer — Browse tables 1-100 (free: 1-12, premium: all) with TTS read-aloud
• Quiz Mode — 20 multiple-choice questions, 4 difficulty levels (free: Easy/Normal, premium: Hard/Very Hard), 4 operations
• Flashcard Mode — Swipeable cards, mark as known/practice
• Timed Challenge — Speed quiz with countdown timer per difficulty
• Statistics — SwiftData-persisted quiz history with line charts & accuracy tracking
